title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Parashat Toledot"

chapters.title: Yitzchak's Background and Trauma
chapters.about: Yitzchak's past, marriage to Rivka, and the lingering emotional impact of the Akedah

chapters.title: Yitzchak's Prayer and Rivka's Conception
chapters.about: Vaye'etar Yitzchak, praying for an akara, and overturning physical decrees

chapters.title: Rivka's Prophecy and Question
chapters.about: Rivka feeling movement, asking lama zeh anochi, and seeking out Hashem

chapters.title: Birth of Yaakov and Esav
chapters.about: The birth of the twins, their physical appearance, and the prophecy of shnei goyim

chapters.title: The Brothers Grow Up and the Birthright
chapters.about: Esav as a hunter and Yaakov as a tent dweller, the soup, and the sale of the bechora

chapters.title: Yitzchak's Aging and the Blessings
chapters.about: Yitzchak's weakened eyesight, his instruction to Esav, and Rivka's intervention

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores Parashat Toledot, focusing on the psychological and spiritual development of Yitzchak, Rivka, Yaakov, and Esav. She discusses Yitzchak's prayer for children, Rivka's seeking of Hashem during a difficult pregnancy, and the dynamics surrounding the birthright and blessings.
questions: How does Yitzchak's experience at the Akedah influence his parenting and his relationship with Esav?
What does the term vaye'etar teach us about prayer and overturning decrees?
Why does Rivka go directly to seek out Hashem during her difficult pregnancy?
How should we understand Esav's mindset when he sells his birthright to Yaakov?
